subject: MUS
courseName: Applied Jazz Theory and Improvisation III

response.courseDescription: 458 Applied Jazz Theory and Improvisation III May be repeated for credit; cumulative maximum 4 hours. Applied study of advanced jazz theory and improvisation concepts including pentatonic scales, Coltrane changes, whole-tone scales, octatonic scales, upper structure triads, triad pairs, intervallic improvisation, and reharmonization techniques.
response.coursePrerequisites: MUS 258 with a C or better.
